title: The Cinnamon Wind's Three Chapters
youtube_title: The Cinnamon Wind's Three Chapters | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Slow sniffing can read a recipe that sun and trees already wrote.
summary: A cinnamon wind tugs Amira, Karim, and Yara through the market until they name warm crust, orange oil, and spice bark and follow the trail.
